## UX / Accessibility Checklist

- [ ] Semantic HTML used (e.g., `<button>` for actions, `<nav>` for navigation)
- [ ] ARIA labels provided for icon-only elements
- [ ] Keyboard navigation verified (tab order, focus states)
- [ ] Color contrast meets WCAG AA standards
- [ ] Images have descriptive alt text (or `alt=""` for decorative)
- [ ] Form inputs have associated `<label>` elements
- [ ] Decorative emojis hidden from screen readers with `aria-hidden="true"`
